en-US.longDescription: Navicat for PostgreSQL is an easy-to-use database management tool designed to simplify the complexities of handling PostgreSQL servers. It supports tasks ranging from managing large datasets and writing simple queries to developing complex data models and conducting data analysis. Navicat for PostgreSQL provides the tools and insights necessary for a smooth GUI experience.
en-US.name: Navicat for PostgreSQL
